# Oxford（牛津）

Oxford is a compact university city where centuries-old colleges,
libraries, and museums sit within a 20-minute walk of each other — most
of it is realistically doable as a single day trip from London.

## Must-See

### Bodleian Library（Bodleian Library）

One of the oldest libraries in Europe, still an active research library
for the University of Oxford. The Divinity School inside it was used as
a filming location for the Harry Potter films, which draws crowds — go
early or book the guided tour to see beyond the entrance hall.

- **Category / area:** library — Central Oxford
- **Photography:** Divinity School's fan-vaulted ceiling is the standout shot; best with the morning light through the south windows.
- **Reservation:** required (guided tour)
- **Hours:** 09:00–17:00
- **Source:** https://example.com/bodleian-hours (checked 2026-07-15)

### Christ Church（Christ Church）

Both an Oxford college and a cathedral, with a dining hall that inspired
the Hogwarts Great Hall. The cathedral itself predates the college by
centuries.

- **Category / area:** college / cathedral — Central Oxford
- **Photography:** the quad and dining hall staircase are the classic shots.
- **Reservation:** recommended
- **Hours:** 10:00–17:00
- **Source:** https://example.com/christ-church-hours (checked 2026-07-15)

### Radcliffe Camera（Radcliffe Camera）

Oxford's most photographed building — a circular reading room that's
part of the Bodleian. Interior access is limited to Oxford students and
researchers; most visitors see it from outside.

- **Category / area:** landmark — Central Oxford
- **Photography:** best viewed/shot from the Bodleian's Old Schools Quad or from University Church across the square, early morning before crowds gather.
- **Reservation:** not_needed
- **Hours:** exterior viewable any time; interior not open to the public
- **Source:** https://example.com/radcliffe-camera (checked 2026-07-15)

## Recommended

### Ashmolean Museum（Ashmolean Museum）

Britain's oldest public museum. Free entry, broad collection from
Egyptian antiquities to modern art — a good lower-energy stop for the
end of the day.

- **Category / area:** museum — Central Oxford
- **Reservation:** not_needed
- **Hours:** 10:00–17:00 (last admission 16:30)
- **Cost:** 0 GBP
- **Source:** https://example.com/ashmolean-hours (checked 2026-07-15)

### Oxford Botanic Garden（Oxford Botanic Garden）

The oldest botanic garden in the UK, small and easy to enjoy in under an
hour, right by Christ Church Meadow.

- **Category / area:** garden — Central Oxford
- **Reservation:** not_needed
- **Hours:** 10:00–17:00
- **Cost:** 6.50 GBP
- **Source:** https://example.com/botanic-garden-hours (checked 2026-07-15)

## Optional

### Covered Market（Covered Market）

A historic indoor market with food stalls, bakeries, and independent
shops — a reliable, casual lunch option without needing a reservation.

- **Category / area:** market — Central Oxford
- **Reservation:** not_needed
- **Hours:** 08:00–17:30
- **Source:** https://example.com/covered-market (checked 2026-07-15)

## Cost-Saving Tips

- Christ Church, the Bodleian tour, and the Botanic Garden all charge
  entry; the Ashmolean and Radcliffe Camera's exterior are free.
- A same-day return train from London booked in advance is cheaper than
  an on-the-day ticket.

## General Notes

- Term-time crowds (especially at Christ Church and the Bodleian) are
  heavier on weekday mornings when tour groups arrive.
